_comment: Qwen3 NATIVE-ACTUATION frozen method (COMP-RPBE revision, review 2026-09-22). The RPBE recursion node is the native CCM merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t with depth D=L and Z_t = M_t; the actuated parameters are the NATIVE compression params (conditional LoRA q/k/v/o r=8 + COMP/SUM comp-embedding rows), the backbone is frozen, and NO Gamma module exists. Native-Ours runs the treewise feasibility projection in ADAMW PROPOSAL space (d_0 = joint proposal, d* = Proj_F(d_0), theta <- theta + d* written back directly). Native-task-only = ordinary AdamW step on the same data stream. The gamma section is kept for the enforce_frozen binding (gamma.hidden) but is NOT attached in native mode.
frozen_source: CCM official dialog protocol (max_steps 1000, lr 3e-4, accum-equivalent 128 effective cuts per window) + Llama-line RPBE structure (chain-wise multi-cut, window-matched cadence), actuation point moved from post-merge Gamma residual to the native compression parameters

actuation.scope: conditional LoRA q/k/v/o r=8 + COMP/SUM comp_embeddings rows (the native CCM compression parameters); recursion node = native merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t, depth D=L; Z_t = M_t via JMemLift unchanged
actuation.theta0: frozen Qwen3 instruct backbone (Step-1 SKIPPED per the CCM README rule for aligned backbones) + FRESH conditional LoRA (PEFT default init, B=0 zero branch) + FRESH COMP/SUM rows (deterministic row-mean init)
actuation.projection_space: AdamW proposal space (review 2026-09-22): d_0 = shadow-AdamW joint proposal from g_task + lambda*g_pred; d* = argmin 1/2||d-d_0||^2 s.t. q_i^T d >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task|| (lower bound in UPDATE space); theta <- theta + d* written back directly, optimizer moments updated with the true-value joint gradient
actuation.lambda_fact: lambda does NOT affect the pure half-space feasibility region (cancels on both sides); lambda is meaningful only through the joint proposal center d_0

backbone.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (aligned instruct backbone: official Step-1 default-LoRA pretraining is SKIPPED per the CCM README rule)

adapter.lora_r_note: r=8 q/k/v/o conditional LoRA — the ONLY trainable parameters together with the COMP/SUM rows (trainable count 5,898,240 + 4 comp rows). lora_dropout pinned to 0.0 for the two-pass replay identity; lora_A's first-step gradient is exactly zero (B=0 zero branch at theta_0), mirroring the gamma-line U/V note.

lambda_calibration.rule: r_eff = lambda * ||d_pred|| / ||d_task|| ~ 0.1, measured on theta_0 (calibration-only run, before ANY optimizer/scheduler step), calibrated once on the initial full window (training-only), then frozen for all seeds. NATIVE-scope measurement (review 2026-09-22): r_eff is the AdamW PROPOSAL-norm ratio on the native compression params (lr=1 direction space — the ratio is lr-invariant; warmup sets the real lr to 0 at theta_0).
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: Calibrated 2026-09-22 (native proposal-space r_eff at theta_0): r_eff = ||d_pred||/||d_task|| = 1.002, derived lambda = 0.1/1.002 = 0.0998.  Contrast: the gamma-line r_eff was 16.28 — on the native compression actuation the predictive proposal is the SAME order as the task proposal.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter (TGN identity is its special case); GQA hosts lift the memory from the KV heads (8) with head_dim 128; native mode lifts the PURE CCM mean (no Gamma residual exists)
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: Four independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r); depth bucket b(L_v) modulates the future signature phi_r.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch; the fixed ridge keeps only its numerical-safety role.

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots — NOT ATTACHED in native mode (kept for the enforce_frozen gamma.hidden binding)
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init: R = U tanh(V [prev;cur;time(t)]) with U.weight exactly 0 and V small random. Step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero (verified: max|dlogit|=0.0 on the 4B smoke).

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4), not a mechanical microbatch count
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the two native arms

training.steps_note: Native Stage B budget = 60 windows (same budget convention as the gamma line).  trainable = conditional LoRA + COMP rows (backbone frozen, NO Gamma).  Native-ours = proposal-space treewise joint feasibility projection; Native-task-only = ordinary AdamW step (arm gamma_task_only + flag).  Sampling = q_L ∝ n_L + replay cap 12 (see sampling section).

official_protocol.data_stream: shuffled epoch loop (each dialogue exactly once per epoch)
official_protocol.micro_batch_note: equal-weight-per-dialogue normalization preserved bit-for-bit (row-wise mean CE / dialogue count); batch>1 is kernel-efficiency only

training.merge_cadence_note: window-matched applies to the RPBE-line arms (ours / gamma_task_only under the depth protocol); the Stage-A official merge run uses the official fixed cadence via the ccm_merge_official arm
training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)
training.rpbe_gamma_only_note: NOT applicable in native mode (the repr scope IS the full trainable set; the flag is refused by the actuation guard)
training.rpbe_lr_note: NOT applicable in native mode (single unified AdamW group; the flag is refused by the actuation guard)

proposal_space.center: d_0 = shadow AdamW proposal of g_joint = g_task + lambda*g_pred (moments read from the CURRENT optimizer state, never stepped)
proposal_space.constraint_norm: ||d_task|| = shadow AdamW proposal norm of the PURE task gradient (snapshotted before the aux accumulation)
proposal_space.half_spaces: q_i^T d* >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task|| (lower bound in update space; feasibility: the update must not turn too far AGAINST a predictive direction)
proposal_space.write_back: theta <- theta + d*; optimizer moments updated with the true-value clipped joint gradient; scheduler/scaler cadence identical to the task-only arm
proposal_space.cert_fail: whole-window skip including the task update (inherited gamma-line semantics), cert_skip_steps recorded

training.seeds_note: Qwen3 line starts with seed 0 only (user ruling, same as the R10 v5 line)
training.eval: native ckpt holds LoRA + COMP rows only -> eval_qwen3_pooled.py --ckpt X --no-gamma (pure CCM-merge forward, unchanged test-time computation); matched-cohort depth curves, primary metric = per-token NLL difference, EOS excluded
training.schedule_note: warmup/cosine over 1000 steps (warmup ratio 0.03): the 60-window native Stage B runs inside the warmup-to-peak region of the original 1000-step schedule (same convention as the gamma line).

sampling.q_alpha_note: q_L ∝ n_L^q_alpha.  q_alpha=1 (natural frequency) RETIRES the R10 inverse-sqrt upweighting (which gave the L=13 pool ~60% of the stream and replayed its 573 dialogues 52-120x each — turn_15 overfitting, diagnosed 2026-09-17).  With the replay cap, every depth pool exhausts its n_L x K budget at the SAME time, so the depth mix stays stable over the whole budget.
sampling.max_replays_note: per-dialogue exposure cap = official 12-epoch semantics (128k samples / 10546 dialogues).  A dialogue leaves its pool after K samples; exhausted depth layers drop out of the draw (q renormalizes over the remaining layers); when all layers are exhausted the counters reset for the next replay cycle.
sampling.rule: depth-stratified legal cuts with natural-frequency depth weights + per-dialogue replay cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id); L=1 dialogues carry task CE only.
sampling.paired_report: scripts/eval_ccm_paired.py (Llama line; Qwen3 line uses protocol C + protocol B curves)

freeze_host.scope: NOT the gamma-line freeze-host protocol.  Native mode freezes the BACKBONE only: trainable = conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM rows; the trainer refuses --freeze-host / --rpbe-gamma-only / --rpbe-lr under native actuation (bidirectional actuation guard)
freeze_host.mode: model.train() throughout (lora_dropout pinned 0.0 keeps the two-pass replay identity)
